description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.5.2 moves `cabf_tls_br.rs` to `pkix-lint-cabf`. That breaks six framework unit tests in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/catalog.rs` (lines 568, 597, 600, 606) and `pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs` (lines 427, 489, 501, 521, 539, 548, 564) that currently use `crate::cabf_tls_br::all_lints()` / `ValidityMaxLint` as their multi-lint fixture set. The integration test file `pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs` also needs to move.

The integration-test move is mechanical. The fixture-test resolution is a design decision.

## What

### Integration tests

1. `git mv pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs pkix-lint-cabf/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs`.
2. Update the `use pkix_lint::cabf_tls_br::*` import (L27–30) to `use pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::*`.
3. Verify the `include_bytes!("../../pkix-path/tests/fixtures/policy-checks/…")` paths resolve — `pkix-lint-cabf`'s CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR is at the same workspace depth as `pkix-lint`'s, so the relative paths should still work, but confirm with a clean `cargo test -p pkix-lint-cabf` run.
4. Extract `metadata_title_defaults_to_id_when_not_overridden` (lines 852–891) — this test defines a synthetic `MinimalLint` and tests the default `Lint::title()` impl. It is framework-only, not CABF-specific. Move it to either `pkix-lint/tests/lint_trait_defaults.rs` (new) or fold into `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs`'s `#[cfg(test)]` block. Pick whichever the team prefers; if uncertain, file a sub-bead with the `human` label.

### OSCAL fixture-test policy (THE design decision)

Six framework unit tests in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/catalog.rs` and `pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs` use CABF lints as their *fixture set*. After the move they cannot import `pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::*` because `pkix-lint` cannot depend on its downstream crate.

Options:

- **(i) Move framework tests to `pkix-lint-cabf`.** Couples framework round-trip tests to the downstream crate. Rejected: framework tests should live with the framework.
- **(ii) Rewrite tests to use `pkix_lint::rfc5280::Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint` + an inline synthetic `MinimalLint` for the multi-lint scenarios.** Some test rewrites required but clean architecturally. Test corpus stays in `pkix-lint`.
- **(iii) Add `pkix-lint-cabf` as a `[dev-dependencies]` of `pkix-lint`.** Reverse-direction edge at test-time only; not a real cycle (dev-deps don't propagate). Cheapest in code-change terms, slightly ugly architecturally.

**Recommendation: option (ii).** Tests document framework behaviour and should not silently rely on downstream lint definitions for their fixtures. The work is bounded — six tests, mostly id-string updates and one new inline `MinimalLint` struct for the duplicate-id case. This decision is requested as human approval; if unclear, label `human` and stop.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-lint-cabf/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs` exists with all 46 CABF tests; `cargo test -p pkix-lint-cabf` passes.
- [ ] `metadata_title_defaults_to_id_when_not_overridden` re-homed in `pkix-lint` and passes.
- [ ] Six fixture tests in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/{catalog,profile}.rs` resolved per the chosen option; `cargo test -p pkix-lint --features oscal` passes.

## Out of scope

- README / rustdoc rewrites (PKIX-amgn.5.4).
- Version bumps (PKIX-amgn.5.5).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.5.2.

## Design question (human approval)

Confirm option (ii) for the OSCAL fixture-test policy. Alternative is (iii); rejected (i).
title: Move CABF integration tests + resolve OSCAL fixture-test policy
